card.name: Recovery 'to' before a Grade level
card.fires_on: The word 'to' (or the gap just before a number) right after 'until improvement/recovery/resolves' and before 'Grade ≤ 1' or 'baseline' in dose-modification tables. It also fires on 'Grade' itself in the same phrase.

modes.label: 'to' after recovery verb
modes.description: The word 'to' following improve, recover, resolve or return, just before a toxicity grade.
modes.example: Interrupt VENCLEXTA and/or acalabrutinib until toxicity resolves<< to>> Grade ≤ 1. Restart VENC

modes.label: Grade or gap before the number
modes.description: The word 'Grade' or the space before the grade number, after 'recovery to'.
modes.example: Dose interruption until recovery to<< Grade>> ≤ 1 then resume KISQ

card.writes: It pushes the model toward grade and criteria words such as 'grade', 'rating' and 'criteria' as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where treatment is held until a side effect improves to a stated grade.
